author: Epic Games
description:
RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0 is OUT NOW! https://epic.gm/dragonwilds

Master survival in a vast new RuneScape world where dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft alone or with up to three friends in online co-op. Survive the dangers of Ashenfall, uncover ancient secrets and prepare to face the ferocious Dragon Queen, Kuldra. 

1.0 introduces the final chapter of Kuldra’s Saga. Master skills from level 1 to 99, earn iconic Skillcapes, wield powerful Skill Spells and craft iconic Rune Armour, then take on the brand-new Scorned Wilderness Raid in the ultimate clash with Kuldra, the God-Eater Dragon Queen. 

The full release also brings together all the content added throughout Early Access, including Major Regional Updates - Fellhollow, Dowdun Reach and Umbral Sands.
